quote.text: The time is at hand when you will have forgotten everything; and the time is at hand when all will have forgotten you. Always reflect that soon you will be no one, and nowhere.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that life is fleeting and moments with your children are transient; use this awareness to cherish every shared smile and learning experience, encouraging mindfulness in everyday interactions.
    • Teach your children the virtue of humility by accepting that both achievements and remembrance fade over time, emphasizing that true fulfillment comes from love, integrity, and the impact they have on others.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that any leadership position is temporary; this perspective fosters humility and reminds you to focus on empowering those around you rather than clinging to titles or legacy.
    • Let the impermanence of success inspire you to lead by example, cultivating resilience and a forward-thinking mindset that values ethical action and collective well-being over transient personal glory.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, acknowledge that market trends and consumer preferences are ever-changing; this realization motivates continual innovation and adaptation to remain relevant.
    • Apply the wisdom of impermanence by focusing on building sustainable value—prioritizing products and solutions that meet genuine needs—while remaining agile and ready to evolve when recognition fades.
